# T03: Created the NativeMenu composable with seven actions and Back behavior

**Created the NativeMenu composable with seven actions, BackHandler integration, and 48dp touch targets; 30 pure-Kotlin tests all passing.**

## What Happened

Created NativeMenu.kt (app/src/main/java/com/example/hub/ui/NativeMenu.kt) — a sibling-overlay composable that renders a 7-action in-session menu without wrapping WebViewHost, preserving WebView identity across open/close cycles. Includes MenuAction sealed class (Resume, SnapshotNow, Checkpoint, Vault, Reload, Display, ReturnToHub), BackHandler integration with deterministic behavior (opens menu when closed, closes when open, never silently navigates back), 48dp minimum touch targets via Modifier.height(48dp), and width-based layout branching (compact <600dp → bottom sheet; wide ≥600dp → side panel) using BoxWithConstraints to avoid the missing androidx.window:window dependency. Added material-icons-extended:1.7.0 to build.gradle.kts for the icon set. Created NativeMenuTest.kt with 30 pure-Kotlin tests covering: seven actions exist and are unique, all labels match spec, BackHandler closes menu without silent navigation, back is no-op when menu closed, menu open/closed mapping for all 9 SessionState values, and action enablement rules per state. Build (assembleDebug) and full unit test suite (95 tests across 8 suites) both pass.

## Verification

Seven menu items render; BackHandler behavior verified (closes menu, does not navigate back silently); 48dp touch targets enforced via height modifier; full unit test suite passes (95/95).

Logcat filter `tag:NativeMenu` shows BackHandler triggers and action triggers. Menu open/closed state transitions are logged at DEBUG level.

## Failures (Q5)

| Dependency | Failure Path | Handling |
|------------|-------------|----------|
| BackHandler callback throws | System back press swallowed; menu stays open | Exception propagates up composition chain — no try/catch |
| onAction callback throws | Action silently fails; menu stays open | Exception propagates up composition chain |
| onBack callback throws | Menu closes but nav back fails | Exception propagates up composition chain |

## Load Profile (Q6)

No runtime load dimension. The menu renders 7 static items. No data loading, no network, no database. The 10x load breakpoint is N/A — no resource saturation possible.
